summary: exfat_hosttest.c, whose cost rows bound twenty creates after two hundred in one directory and a lookup of the last name, with faults in rach2/sys/fs/exfat.c in the scan, the unlink and the rename

argv:
set -e
t=${WORK}/tree
rm -rf "$t"
mkdir -p "$t/rach2" "$t/tests/host"
cp -R rach2/sys "$t/rach2/sys"
cp -R tests/host/compat "$t/tests/host/compat"
cp tests/host/exfat_hosttest.c "$t/tests/host/"
cp -R ${SRC}/. "$t/"
cd "$t"
for x in exfat_hosttest; do
    deps=$(grep -oE 'host-deps:[^*]*' tests/host/$x.c | sed 's/host-deps://' | tr '\n' ' ')
    ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -DFIXDIR='"${WORK}/fixtures"' -I rach2/sys -I rach2/sys/lib -I rach2/sys/proc -I ${TREE}/utils -I ${TREE}/krffs -I tests/host/compat -o ${WORK}/$x tests/host/$x.c $deps
done

faults.name: filler
faults.summary: the filler entry at a sector's last slot written at every scan that passes it

lines: exfat_hosttest: FAIL: the twenty creates after the first two hundred write at most 60 times

faults.name: entry
faults.summary: a cache get for every 32-byte entry, the mount's copy of the block ignored

lines: exfat_hosttest: FAIL: and take at most 4000 cache gets

faults.name: upcase
faults.summary: every up-case walked in the stored table from its start, the mappings read at mount ignored

lines: exfat_hosttest: FAIL: and take at most 4000 cache gets

faults.name: grow
faults.summary: the caller's set left for the directory's growth to overwrite

lines: exfat_hosttest: FAIL: the volume is consistent after two hundred and twenty creates

faults.name: unlink
faults.summary: an unlink that answers 0 once it has found the set, with nothing retired or freed

lines: exfat_hosttest: FAIL: the file unlinked while held is gone
exfat_hosttest: FAIL: the file unlinked after a sync is gone

faults.name: rename
faults.summary: an in-place rename rewrite with the file entry in another sector

edits.find: uint32_t per_sector = BLOCK_SECTOR_SIZE / 32, sector = src->index / per_sector;

faults.name: overflow
faults.summary: a rename past 256 entries that drops the source's last benign secondaries in place of ENAMETOOLONG

lines: exfat_hosttest: FAIL: and a name of seventeen entries, past 256, is ENAMETOOLONG
